item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. High temperatures this afternoon range from forty-nine to fifty-one degrees with mostly cloudy skies and a good chance of rain showers, especially in the Champlain Valley and Essex County, while lows tonight fall between thirty-six and thirty-nine degrees under mostly cloudy skies and lingering showers tapering off. Expect precipitation chances today from around fifteen percent up to sixty-two percent, with the highest likelihood of rain in the Champlain Valley and Essex County, and tonight’s precipitation chances running from about thirty-four percent to sixty-five percent before skies remain mostly cloudy overnight.
